live.disconnected: Live updates disconnected. Showing the last loaded data.
live.reconnecting: Reconnecting live updates… You can keep working.
form.label_required: Enter an English label (required for fallback).
form.choice_required: Add at least one answer choice.
form.mapping_required: Choose a matching target for this answer, or turn off matching for the whole question.
form.mapping_duplicate: Only one question can map to each matching field.
participant.my_desc: Events you have registered for with this Discord account.
participant.my_empty_desc: Open an event’s signup page from your Discord server and register with your Discord account. You must be a current server member.
participant.team_desc: Create a team, or join an open team for this hackathon.
participant.team_leave_desc: You will leave the team {name}. You can join another open team later.
participant.team_empty_desc: Create a team or check back later.
participant.team_complete: Complete your event registration before joining a team.
participant.team_full: That team is full. Choose another team.
participant.team_conflict: That team changed. Refresh and try again.
participant.signup_login_desc: We check your membership before saving your registration.
participant.signup_load_error: Could not load your registration. Try again.
participant.signup_member: You must be a current member of this event’s Discord server to register.
participant.signup_required: Complete the required answers before continuing.
participant.signup_save_error: Check required answers and try again.
participant.signup_stale: The signup form changed. Reload it to keep compatible answers, then review and save.
participant.signup_review: Form updated. Review your answers before saving.
participant.signup_failed: Your registration was not saved. Try again.
participant.signup_profile_required: Choose your experience, role, at least one skill, and team preference.
participant.signup_empty: Signup is unavailable because the organizer has not configured any participant questions yet.
participant.signup_skill_groups: Choose one skill per group. Choosing another replaces your previous selection in that group.
participant.team_no_event: Open teams from a completed event registration.
login.tagline: Organizer console — sign in to run the event
events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Create, configure and run hackathon events
events.none_desc: Create your first event, configure the signup form, then activate it.
events.create_desc: Starts as a draft. Activate when the signup panel is ready.
events.name: Name
events.announce_desc: Posts to the signup panel channel. DMs go to every active signup.
events.end_confirm_before: Team roles, channels and Discord events are cleaned up automatically
events.end_confirm_after: after the end time — people keep a grace window to grab photos and screenshots (warnings go out at 72h and 24h before removal). Data is kept for archive. Change the delay in the event config below.
events.cleanup_delay_aria: Cleanup delay in hours after the event ends
events.cleanup_delay_saved: Cleanup delay set to {hours}h after the event ends
events.ql_teams: Inspect team spaces, kick, rotate codes
events.no_active: No active event — create and activate one first; the other tabs operate on it.
events.template_hint: Pre-fills name, description and form from a saved event template.
events.new_event_hint: Create a fresh event from scratch.
events.chooser_desc: Start blank or from a saved event template.
events.no_templates_hint: No templates yet — save an event as template first in Templates.
events.edit_schedule_desc: Times are shown locally. Drag ideas: 12:00 Fika, 18:00 Dinner, 14:00 Voting, Prize ceremony.
events.signup_hint: people can sign up during this period, before the hackathon
events.signup_after_hint: Schedule blocks below must be after signup closes. They’re for the hackathon itself.
events.schedule_start_hack_hint: When the hackathon starts — add an announcement or post the signup panel to open signups on a timer.
events.schedule_end_hack_hint: When the hackathon ends — add a wrap-up announcement if you want.
events.activated_schedule: “{name}” is now active — schedule actions will fire at their times. Add a “Post signup” + announcements to your Start block to open on a timer.
events.schedule_signup_desc: Posts the interactive signup panel to the channel below at this time. Add this to your Start block to open signups on a timer instead of on Activate.
events.schedule_lock_desc: When this block hits, teams are locked — no more auto-matches until you unlock. Runs before any announcements in this block.
events.schedule_auto_desc: Runs matching for everyone who chose “Get matched into a random team” and locks teams.
events.schedule_distribute_desc: Sends the event's assignment pool to each team's channel when this block hits.
events.schedule_actions_empty: Nothing runs when this block hits yet — add an action below. Type { in an announcement message for tag suggestions.
events.form_default_desc: Event template's form, or the guild default.
events.form_default_hint: Nothing is sent — the chosen event template's form wins, otherwise the guild default form.
events.form_build_desc: Create a fresh signup form right here.
events.form_build_hint: Saved as a new form template when you create the event — it appears under Templates → Form templates.
events.form_template_hint: Use a saved form template for this event's signup. Default is the global form.
events.change_form_desc: Pick a form template to replace this event's signup form. Participants already signed up keep their data.
participants.title: Participants
participants.desc: Move people between teams, block or remove signups
participants.none_desc: Once people use /hackathon join in Discord, they appear here.
participants.block_desc: They can no longer sign up or update their signup, and they are removed from any team. You can unblock them later.
teams.none_desc: Teams appear here when participants create them, or when you run matching.
teams.create_desc: Public teams show up in /hackathon teams for anyone to join. Private teams need a join code.
teams.name: Team name
teams.kind_public: Public — anyone can ask to join
teams.kind_private: Private — invite or join code only
teams.delete_desc: Members stay signed up but become unteamed. This cannot be undone.
teams.settings_desc: Rename, flip visibility or recolor the Discord role. Changes apply immediately.
matching.title: Compatibility matching
matching.desc: Builds teams from unteamed participants who opted into matching. Mutual friend requests are kept together; scores blend role complementarity, skill overlap/diversity and experience mix.
matching.stale_preview: The preview changed. Preview again before committing.
matching.nobody_desc: Participants who pick “match me into a team” in the signup form appear here.
matching.need_one_desc: Matching needs at least 2 participants who opted in and have no team.
matching.ready_desc: Run a preview to draft teams. Nothing is saved until you commit.
matching.commit_desc: Existing teams stay together. These new teams are formed only from eligible, unteamed participants who opted into matching, and announced in Discord. You can run matching again later for new unteamed participants.
form.title: Signup form
form.desc: Controls the /hackathon join modal: title, intro text, team size and the option lists.
form.role_tracks_hint: The main role a person signs up for. IDs: frontend, backend, fullstack, design, devops, flex.
form.skills_hint: Skills within the same group are mutually exclusive (e.g. backend languages). Empty group = freely combinable.
form.reset_desc: Your custom title, team size and option lists are replaced with the built-in defaults. Existing signups are kept but may reference removed options.
form.updated: Form updated — the Discord modal now uses it
form.save_template_desc: Reuse this form setup for future events. The template is saved for this guild.
form.templates_desc: Saved form setups. Apply one to replace the draft above.
form.custom_questions_hint: Stable IDs preserve answers. Private questions are excluded from matching.
operate.title: Operations
operate.subtitle: Participants, teams and matching — one flow.
templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Form and event templates — create once, reuse everywhere. Events can pick a specific form.
templates.event_templates_desc: Saved event snapshots (name, description, cleanup, form). Use when creating events.
templates.form_templates_desc: Saved signup forms. Apply to the global form or pick when creating events.
templates.theme_desc: Reusable appearance settings. Applying a theme copies its values into a form.
templates.theme_name_required: Name must be at least 2 characters
templates.theme_delete_desc: This removes the saved preset. Forms that already use it remain unchanged.
templates.no_event_templates: No event templates yet — create one from an event below.
templates.no_form_templates: No form templates yet — save the form below or create one.
templates.new_event_template_desc: Save an existing event as a reusable template.
templates.new_form_template_desc: Saves the current global form as a new template.
config.title: Config
config.subtitle: Guild defaults — new events inherit these unless you override them.
config.defaults_desc: Used when you create events. You can still override per-event.
config.default_schedule_hint: Where the full itinerary with Discord timers (<t:…>) is posted.
config.announce_hint: Where announcements are posted if you don't pick one.
config.category_hint: Discord category where team channels/roles are created.
config.cleanup_hint: Hours after an event ends before team spaces are removed (0–720).
config.moderator_desc: Who can run /hackathon admin in Discord without Manage Server. ADMIN_IDS and Manage Server / Administrator always work.
config.moderator_no_roles: No roles found — is the bot in the guild and does it have access? You need to set DISCORD_GUILD_ID and restart.
config.no_channels_hint: No channels found — is the bot in the guild? You can still paste IDs.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.none_desc: Admin actions, signups and matching runs are recorded here.
charts.composition_desc: Active signups by role track, split by experience · {count} active
events.schedule_offset_hint: Day 1 is the anchor's own day — 0 or negative numbers are earlier days. Real dates are set when the event is created.
events.schedule_relative_hint: Template schedule — blocks are placed relative to an anchor, so the itinerary adapts to whatever dates the event gets.
events.schedule_relative_empty: No blocks yet — add dinner, breaks, voting etc. and pick what each one is relative to.
events.schedule_signup_hack_hint: Nothing runs when signups open yet — add “Post signup” to open the panel on a timer.
events.section_live_hint: running now — also listed in Operations
events.section_ended_hint: past events — cleanup follows the configured delay
events.cleanup_delay_hint: Hours after the event ends before team channels and roles are cleaned up.
events.schedule_edit_hint: Edit blocks, times and actions via Edit event.
events.schedule_hint: Blocks run at their times — each can announce, post signup or lock teams.
events.schedule_empty_desc: Add the itinerary — dinner, breaks, voting, prizes. Each block can post an announcement, open signups or lock teams when it hits.
login.discord_hint: You must own a server, be an administrator, or have an organizer role assigned by its owner or an administrator; the bot must be installed there.
login.auth_failed: Discord sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
login.auth_no_guild: You do not manage any server the bot is in. Ask an organizer for access, or invite the bot to your server.
login.access_refused: Your server access changed. Sign in again, then ask a server administrator to restore access if needed.
login.auth_misconfigured: Discord sign-in is not configured correctly (redirect URI). An organizer must fix the setup.
server.label: Server
color.hex_invalid: Not a hex colour — the saved colour is unchanged.
form.appearance_help: These settings change the public signup appearance only; saved answers and matching are unchanged.
form.banner_help: Optional image loaded by the participant's browser. Only HTTPS URLs are accepted.
form.version_hint: Cosmetic labels and themes keep the version. Changing question structure on a published event with registrations requires an explicit version migration.
events.form_conflict: This published event has registrations. Create an explicit version migration before changing question structure.
events.keep_form: Leave empty to keep the current form.
imports.title: Imported signups
imports.discord_limitation: Imported signups are saved separately. They cannot join matching or receive Discord roles/channels until required answers are complete and you explicitly link a current server member.
imports.empty_desc: Upload a UTF-8 CSV to review and save signup responses for this event.
imports.no_matches: No imported signups match these filters.
imports.unlinked_detail: Discord identity is not verified. Imported username: {username}.
imports.limits: UTF-8 CSV only · maximum 1 MB, 2,000 rows, 100 columns, and 10,000 characters per cell. Preview does not save anything.
imports.file_too_large: The CSV exceeds the 1 MB limit. Choose a smaller file.
imports.file_read_failed: Could not read this file as text.
imports.save_failed: Could not save these signups. Your review is still available; retry safely.
imports.name: Name and class
imports.edit_desc: Answers and source details are visible to organizers only. Saving does not infer a Discord identity.
imports.link_explanation: Search by server name or Discord username. Choose the exact member, then confirm; the server checks membership again.
imports.link_eligibility: A link alone does not activate this signup. Required answers and current event eligibility still apply.
participant.edit_hint: Your answers are saved. You can come back and change them.
participant.profile_hint: Tell us what you enjoy building. We’ll use this to help you find your people.
participant.questions_hint: A few things your organizers would like to know.
participant.next_hint: Bring your friends or meet someone new. Your team space is always one tab away.
participant.your_events: Your next good idea starts here.
participant.team_workspace: A space for your next idea
participant.team_create_hint: Start a team and invite the people you want to build with.
form.signup_mode_help: Website only opens the full form directly. Discord + website collects the profile in Discord, then links to any remaining required questions.
form.discord_limit: Custom questions are answered on the website. Discord’s profile modal has no room for extra questions; participants will see a link before they start.
form.participant_channels_help: At kickoff, give registered participants an event role and restrict the announcement and schedule channels to it. Keep the signup channel separate and public. Requires Manage Roles and Manage Channels.
login.headline: Make room for great ideas.
login.intro: The people, the teams, the weekend. Bring your hackathon together in one place.
login.organizer: For the people behind the hackathon
login.community: A good weekend starts with good company.
form.matching_explanation: How these answers help form teams
form.matching_summary: Matching uses experience, role and skills to suggest balanced teams. Skills in the same group are mutually exclusive. You can review the suggested teams in Operations before committing them.
form.basics_help: Give participants a clear welcome and tell them what to expect.
templates.delete_desc: This removes the reusable template. Events already created from it are kept.

imports.csv_only: Choose a .csv file. Export Excel or Google Sheets as CSV first.
imports.file_empty: This file is empty. Choose a CSV containing a header and at least one signup.

imports.access_denied: You no longer have organizer access to this server. Check your server permissions, then return and retry.
imports.origin_error: The request came from a different website address. Open the console using its configured address and retry.

servers.title: Your communities
servers.description: Choose the server you want to organize. Next time, we’ll open your last chosen workspace automatically.
servers.empty: No manageable servers found. The bot must be installed and you need server ownership, Administrator permission, or an assigned organizer role.
servers.load_error: We couldn’t check your server access. Try again in a moment.
servers.enter_error: This server is no longer available to you. Your server list has been refreshed.
templates.message_help: Write a reusable Discord message. Type { to insert event or schedule details. Schedule variables only have values when a schedule activity sends the message.
templates.name: Template name
common.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in in another tab, then retry. Keep this tab open to preserve your edits.
imports.network_error: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and retry; your import is still here.
